arguments.script: var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();try{foreach(var path in System.IO.Directory.GetFiles("Assets/Scenes","*.unity").Where(p=>!p.Contains("MainMenu"))){var s=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(path);var roots=s.GetRootGameObjects();var maps=roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>(true)).ToArray();var rs=roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>(true)).Where(r=>r.sprite&&r.enabled&&(r.name.StartsWith("GroundTile")||r.GetComponentsInParent<UnityEngine.Transform>(true).Any(t=>t.name=="Terrain"))).ToArray();lines.Add(s.name+" maps="+maps.Length+" renderers="+rs.Length);foreach(var m in maps){var ts=new UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TileBase[m.GetUsedTilesCount()];m.GetUsedTilesNonAlloc(ts);lines.Add(" map "+m.name+" used="+string.Join(",",ts.Select(t=>UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(t)).Distinct().Take(6)));}foreach(var r in rs.Take(4))lines.Add(" sprite "+r.name+" "+UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(r.sprite)+" pos="+r.transform.position+" scale="+r.transform.lossyScale+" size="+r.bounds.size);}}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/rock-all-levels-20261111/inventory.txt",lines);}
arguments.summary: Inventory editable terrain across every scene
